name: Araunah
overview: The biblical account of Araunah, also known as Ornan, reveals him as a Jebusite from whom King David purchased a threshing floor to build an altar to the LORD, as directed by the prophet Gad. This event occurs after the angel of the LORD had been sent to Jerusalem to execute judgment, but was commanded to stay his hand near Araunah’s threshing floor. David’s willingness to buy the site for an altar highlights the importance of proper worship and sacrifice to halt the plague affecting Israel, demonstrating God’s mercy and the king’s intercession on behalf of the people.
